answer: SELECT s.Street, s.City, s.Zip, s.State FROM schools s JOIN satscores sc ON s.CDSCode = sc.cds WHERE sc.NumTstTakr > 0 ORDER BY (COALESCE(sc.NumGE1500,0)*1.0/sc.NumTstTakr) ASC LIMIT 1;
SELECT f.`School Name` FROM frpm f JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode WHERE s.DOCType = 'State Special Schools' ORDER BY f.`Enrollment (K-12)` DESC LIMIT 1;
SELECT GSoffered FROM schools ORDER BY Longitude DESC LIMIT 1;

SELECT f.`School Name`, s.DOCType FROM frpm f JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode WHERE s.FundingType = 'Locally funded' AND (f.`Enrollment (K-12)` - f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`) > (SELECT AVG(f2.`Enrollment (K-12)` - f2.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`) FROM frpm f2 JOIN schools s2 ON f2.CDSCode = s2.CDSCode WHERE s2.FundingType = 'Locally funded');
SELECT f.`School Name` FROM frpm f JOIN satscores sc ON f.CDSCode = sc.cds WHERE f.`Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)` > 0.1 AND sc.NumGE1500 > 0;
SELECT County, COUNT(*) FROM schools WHERE County IN ('San Diego','Santa Barbara') AND Virtual = 'F' GROUP BY County ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1;
